question: Does current V2 provide one stable deployment interface with versioned release loading, legality-safe host contracts, diagnostics and focused regression coverage?
decision: ACCEPT: The current V2 has one stable SkatAI runtime and host interface across bidding, declaration, discard and legality-constrained cardplay, with versioned release loading and focused host, product-interface, release-loader and release-package regression coverage. This accepts the interface criterion only; JSkat Java callbacks, Windows packaging, actual user-host deployment, remote publication and gameplay-strength promotion remain separate decisions.
